correctionsReviewed.note: Original 2020 SSR/SNP paper supports full-sibling relationships among these four; do not repeat older parent–offspring or colour-mutation claims. Named parental pair unresolved.
CNR VitisDB confirms Bianchetta Genovese synonymy; older CREA morphology-based descriptions may separate historical names. Do not confuse Bianchetta Trevigiana.

White Asti/Moscato d’Asti composition is minimum 97% Moscato Bianco; 2026 adds Rosé with 70–90% Moscato Bianco and 10–30% Brachetto. Do not assert all Asti is 100% Muscat or necessarily sweet. National effect 23 March 2026; do not invent separate EU-publication date.
2021 amendment supersedes older consortium PDF: Freisa minimum 90%, with Superiore six-month minimum wood ageing and release from 1 November following harvest.

One legal PDO with two names. Minimum Brachetto 97%; includes dry-to-sweet still red/rosé, extra-brut-to-sweet sparkling red/rosé and sweet red Passito. Older blanket 100%/sweet-only descriptions are incomplete.
Use operative 2020 specification rather than linked 2014 PDF. Riserva requires 24 months including 12 in wood; bare Vigna does not by itself impose Riserva ageing.

note.en: The matched registered Spergola genotype is identical to Vernaccia di Oristano in Raimondi et al. 2020. Homonymous accessions require authentication; do not assert every historical Spergola accession is identical.
note.zh: Raimondi 等 2020 年研究确认匹配的登记 Spergola 基因型与 Vernaccia di Oristano 相同；同名材料须鉴定，不应宣称所有历史同名材料皆相同。
